_comment: 'If Scour the Battlescape is played from arsenal, it gains go again.' Same sentence and same fix as frontline_scout_red and promise_of_plenty_red, both already converted and verified: the PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL gate was authored correctly but hung off a PLAY ability, which conditional_keywords cannot see, so the printed GoAgain applied unconditionally and the card had go again from hand. The put-a-card-back/draw clause is a separate ability and is untouched.
